data.name: Buiron
data.gender_notes: Buiron is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'buo', meaning 'to be', and 'oros', meaning 'mountain'. The name Buiron signifies a strong and mighty mountain, which can symbolize a person's inner strength and resilience. The name Buiron carries the meaning “Strong, mighty mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Buiron usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, mighty mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of steadfastness and endurance, reminding us to remain strong in our faith and overcome life's challenges.
data.etymology: Buiron belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, mighty mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Buiron total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name Buiron can serve as a constant reminder of the importance of seeking spiritual guidance and growth.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Buiron represents the inner mountain that each person must climb to reach enlightenment and union with God. It signifies the journey of self-discovery, transformation, and growth that we all embark on in our lives. The name Buiron can serve as a source of inspiration and motivation to overcome the challenges and hardships that we face and to continue striving towards our spiritual goals. The name can also serve as a reminder of the strength and resilience that we possess within ourselves, and to belong to God, who is our ultimate source of strength and sustenance.
